nodes.label: Sentinel SDD Progress Ledger
nodes.rationale: One line per task / defect / decision; details live in MEMORY.md, not here.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Complete (Tasks 1-13)
nodes.rationale: Task 13 found two pieces recorded as shipped in Task 3 that did not exist — downloadBhavcopy always threw and downloadIndexSeries was never written — so the daily sync recorded a successful nse-bhavcopy step having done nothing: the silent degradation PRD 8.2 exists to forbid, inside the job whose whole contract is loud failure.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Task 1 — Paper Approval State Machine
nodes.rationale: FR-20-25 advisory path ACKNOWLEDGED to AWAITING_MANUAL_EXECUTION to VERIFIED/ABANDONED, defer resurfacing with composite-score check, and paper simulations; limit-order expiry deferred because the PRD is silent.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Task 2 — Rails, Freeze, Breaker
nodes.rationale: checkRails, checkPortfolioRails, freeze/unfreeze with typed confirmation, a three-falsification breaker with mandatory post-mortem, 48h cooling on rail changes and drawdown gating at 15%/20%.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Task 3 — Legacy Cleanup + Multi-Year LTCG Calendar
nodes.rationale: All output is FR-11 paper recommendations with two alternates; unknown cost basis surfaces as an owner prerequisite rather than zero, and no run executes cleanup, disposes lots or consumes a real exemption.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Task 4 — Web Approval/Cleanup/Rail Surfaces
nodes.rationale: Every API action writes an append-only order_transitions row plus an audit_log entry and mirrors the Telegram bot's platform functions, so the two surfaces cannot drift.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Task 5 — Scheduling, Scoring and Backup/Restore Proof
nodes.rationale: Every scheduled action is idempotent via an idempotency key or an existing-simulation check; the restore script is the proof that the encrypted weekly dump is recoverable, verifying table counts, immutability triggers and RLS.

nodes.label: Phase 2 Task 6 — Provisioning, Handoff and Phase 2 Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Tests cannot replace four elapsed weeks of paper operation or five real owner approval interactions, so the Phase 2 DoD stays open and the owner's paper-scorecard review gates Phase 3.

nodes.label: Cash Ceiling Owner Amendment (out of band)
nodes.rationale: Written TDD with four tests red first; a pre-existing test named 'honours a changed rail' asserted only toBeDefined() and passed against code that read nothing, so it was rewritten to prove a DB value actually changes the verdict. The B3 collision was surfaced to the owner, not silently absorbed.

nodes.label: Web App Build Fix (out of band)
nodes.rationale: Rejected from the prior draft: a mock Db returning empty rows at build time and MOCK_APPROVED/MOCK_REJECTED responses — an approval endpoint that answers success when it cannot reach the database is the one thing this product must never do.

nodes.label: Screener Screen HTML Scraper (post-Phase-1)
nodes.rationale: screener.in's CSV export is paywalled but a public screen URL is not, so parseScreenHtml reads the rendered table directly; re-importing the same (as_of, filename) deletes the prior batch because screener_uploads is append-only and ON CONFLICT cannot update.
